resolvedFindings.priorIssue: Silent trace-write failure and credited failed bytes
resolvedFindings.resolution: All writes use appendLocked. Success alone credits data bytes; failure permanently latches write-error and emits the fixed out-of-band CAVE_SCROLL_TRACE_WRITE_ERROR marker once. No arbitrary path/error payload, retry or reopen. note returns false and the pan observer stops; preexisting callback failures prevent subsequent reservations. Terminal write failures cannot be replaced by nominal deadline/byte-cap reasons.
resolvedFindings.residualLimit: A failing write can partially commit its final record. Counter completeness and marker collection remain observational limits; the manifest now states this.

resolvedFindings.priorIssue: Stale same-scroll-view probe detach could stop replacement observer
resolvedFindings.resolution: Each attachment now has a UUID stored by its probe and coordinator. Detach/dismantle supplies that token and only matching generation can stop the current observer. Actual scroll-view replacement stops the stored old observer and clears its token. Same-view replacement followed by old-probe detach no longer matches the new token.
